title: Second voice download: 'you have everything you need'

tellings.quote: The second one I got which was time uh the download was you are you have everything you need

plain: A Hollywood writer named Brent Friedman says that the second time a message, which he calls a "download," came into his mind, it told him: "you have everything you need." Friedman tells it as something he experienced himself, one of a series of such messages.
